sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Notice box and its parts
sections.what: Defines the notice box with its two looks, plus the title and the description text. A notice shows a bordered box with a message and the red style for warnings.
sections.why: Gives every notice in the app the same layout and colors.
sections.watch_out: Because the box uses the alert role, screen readers will announce it immediately, so use it only for messages that need attention.

summary: A styled notice box for messages such as warnings or errors, with a normal and a red style.
purpose: Shows an important message on a page, with a title and a short description.
why: Likely reason: a reusable notice with a fixed alert role so screen readers announce it. Reason not stated for the specific style choices.
how: Step 1: Defines two looks, default and destructive (red). Step 2: Builds the outer box with the alert role and the chosen look. Step 3: Builds the title and the description text. Step 4: Makes the three parts available to other files.
inputs: Title and description text, an optional variant of default or destructive, and any extra style classes or attributes.
outputs: A bordered box with a message on screen. The destructive variant uses a red border and red text.
risks: The alert role makes screen readers announce the box as soon as it appears, so overusing it is disruptive. The title is drawn as a level-five heading, which can make the page's heading order look wrong.
debug: If the wrong colors show, check the variant value passed in. If an icon overlaps the text, check that the icon is placed directly before the text and that the page does not change the spacing.
